sections.heading: The Thought of Norea
sections.body: *Translated by Samuel Zinner; edited by Mark Mattison (Other Gospels Nag Hammadi Initiative)*

sections.heading: 1. Norea's Prayer
sections.body:
**1.** Father of the All, [Insight] of the Light,
 Mind [abiding] in the heights above the lower realm.
 Light abiding [in the] heights,
 Voice of Truth, upright Mind.

**2.** Ungraspable Word and [inexpressible] Voice,
 [unfathomable] Father!

sections.heading: 2. Norea Exalted
sections.body:
**1.** Norea calls out to them.

**2.** They [heard]; they welcomed her into her everlasting abode.

**3.** To her they gave the Father of [Mind], Adamas, and in the [two] voices of the holy ones,

**4.** so that she would rest in the inexpressible Thought, so that [she] would inherit the First Mind that [she] had received,

**5.** and that [she] would rest in the Self-Begotten Divine, and that she might beget herself, even as [she] inherited the [living] Word,

**6.** and that she would be unified with all the imperishable ones, and [speak] with the mind of the Father.

sections.heading: 3. Norea Speaks
sections.body:
**1.** And [she began] speaking with words of [life], and [she] continued in the [presence] of the Exalted One, [possessing what] she had been given before the world existed.

**2.** [She possesses] the [great mind] of the unseen ones, [and she gives] glory to [her] Father,

**3.** [and she] abides within those who [...] within the Fullness,

**4.** [and] she gazes on the Fullness.

sections.heading: 4. Norea Complete
sections.body:
**1.** Days will come when she will [gaze on] the Fullness,

**2.** and she will not abide in the Deficiency,

**3.** because she has the four holy helpers interceding for her with the Father of the All, Adamas.

**4.** It is he who is within all of the Adams, possessing the thought of Norea, who speaks of two names that signify one name.

---
